Punjab Kings Player and Family Accused of Verbal Abuse

A case has been filed against Punjab Kings player Shashank Singh and his father for allegedly verbally abusing their cook in Bhopal. The incident reportedly occurred over food, leading to threats being issued. Authorities have booked the duo, sparking concerns about the treatment of staff in professional sports environments.
